newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-VILLA AIM TO SIGN COLLYMORE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VILLA AIM TO SIGN COLLYMORE.

text.p: Aston Villa were having talks with Liverpool and England striker Stan Collymore on Monday over a reported club record seven million pounds ($11.4 million) transfer.
Collymore was expected to sign for Villa on Tuesday, subject to a medical, with a view to linking up with the squad on their end-of-season tour of the United States.
Villa had a 4.5 million pounds ($7.3 million) offer for the former Nottingham Forest forward rejected earlier in the season.
